cases_batch4_E2E_0.question: Find the highest-rated restaurants in Nagercoil
cases_batch4_E2E_0.golden_sql: SELECT sd.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM shop_details sd JOIN subcategories sc ON sc.id = sd.subcategory_id JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = sd.id JOIN reviews r ON r.shop_id = sd.id WHERE sd.status = 1 AND sa.is_default = 1 AND sa.city = 'Nagercoil' AND sc.subcategoryname = 'Restaurent' GROUP BY sd.id, sd.name HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 4 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 5;

T003.question: Show me top rated restaurants in Colachel with at least a 4 star rating.
T003.golden_sql: SELECT sd.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM shop_details sd JOIN subcategories sc ON sc.id = sd.subcategory_id JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = sd.id JOIN reviews r ON r.shop_id = sd.id WHERE sd.status = 1 AND sa.is_default = 1 AND sa.city = 'Colachel' AND sc.subcategoryname = 'Restaurent' GROUP BY sd.id, sd.name HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 4 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC;

T079.question: How much money did bookings bring in each month?
T079.golden_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(final_amount) AS revenue FROM bookings WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month;
